source.data_source: CFL3D Spalart-Allmaras solution on finest grid (2369x449, ~1.06M cells). Forces from cfl3d_forces.csv; wake minvel from cfl3d_minvel.csv.
source.cross_code_check: FUN3D values within ~1% of CFL3D on Cl/Cd; wake minvel within ~0.001 absolute.

mesh_cell_count.description: Total cell count of the airfoil mesh
mesh_cell_count.T_good_source: TMR coarsest grid is 149x29 (~4k); a wall-resolved 2D RANS with airfoil and wake refinement typically requires ~50k-200k cells. Hand-set.

final_residual_U.T_good_source: Hand-set; low-speed RANS on attached airfoil flow routinely reaches 1e-5 over 4 decades.

cl.T_good_source: CFL3D-SA on 2369x449 grid: Cl=0.161 (DSMA-661 has positive camber, non-zero CL at alpha=0). T_good ~9% allows turbulence-model spread.

cd.T_good_source: CFL3D-SA on 2369x449 grid: Cd=0.0101 = 101 drag-counts. T_good=10 dc / ~10% allows turbulence-model + grid spread.

cdp.T_good_source: CFL3D-SA on 2369x449 grid: Cdp=1.53e-3 (~15% of total). Wider relative tolerance because pressure-drag is sensitive to trailing-edge flow capture.

cdv.T_good_source: CFL3D-SA on 2369x449 grid: Cdv=8.54e-3 (~85% of total).

wake_min_u_at_xc_1p05.description: Minimum streamwise velocity (u/U_inf) across the wake at x/c=1.05 (just behind TE — deepest deficit)
wake_min_u_at_xc_1p05.T_good_source: CFL3D-SA on 2369x449 grid: u_min=0.548 at x/c=1.05. T_good ~9% to allow turbulence-model spread on near-wake mixing rate.

wake_min_u_at_xc_1p40.T_good_source: CFL3D-SA on 2369x449 grid: u_min=0.783 at x/c=1.40.

wake_min_u_at_xc_3p00.T_good_source: CFL3D-SA on 2369x449 grid: u_min=0.909 at x/c=3.00. Tighter T_good in absolute terms because wake has recovered and asymptotic value is well-constrained.
